text: dsh-papercut 是通过 DSH 工具接口驱动剪纸风格解说短片制作的插件。它提供从一句主题创建 Remotion 集数骨架、列出已有集数、生成旁白音频与逐词时间轴、整理分镜、渲染 MP4 以及抽帧生成联系表的工具。脚本和场景内容由使用者或 agent 编写，插件负责衔接制作步骤。适合希望在 DSH 中规划、配音、渲染并检查竖屏解说视频的创作者。语音可经本机 TTS 桥接服务合成，需配置工作区及本地渲染环境。

dsh-papercut connects DSH tools for making cut-paper explainer films. It scaffolds Remotion episodes, synthesizes narration with word timings, derives storyboards, renders MP4 files, and creates frame contact sheets. Users write scripts and scenes; a workspace and local TTS bridge are required.
想在 DSH 里把一个主题整理成剪纸风格解说短片。
我需要给短片生成逐词字幕时间轴，再渲染成视频。
I want to scaffold, narrate, render, and review a cut-paper explainer from DSH.
dsh-papercut 的功能「短片制作流程」：用 papercut_plan 建立集数骨架，再用 papercut_voice 合成旁白并生成逐词时间轴，最后由 papercut_render 输出 MP4。
dsh-papercut 的功能「分镜与画面检查」：papercut_storyboard 根据渲染计划整理镜头和转场，papercut_qa 从成片抽帧并生成带帧号的联系表。

dsh-papercut README · dsh-papercut：**Papercut explainer films, end to end — natively on Windows, no WSL.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that turns one sentence of
idea into a finished vertical (9:16) cut-paper explainer: script → local text-to-speech →
word-level timed captions → Remotion render → QA contact sheets.

dsh-papercut README · Why this exists：The upstream [papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) library is a
beautiful Remotion kit, but its toolchain is 27 bash and Python scripts written for macOS
(Apple `rsync`, `mlx-whisper`, Homebrew `ffmpeg`, `readlink -f`). Everything that touches the
OS has been rewritten here in Node, so the whole pipeline runs on a stock Windows machine:

dsh-papercut README · Why this exists：| Piece | Upstream | Here |
|---|---|---|
| Choreography | `render.py` + `render.sh` | `src/node/render.js` — one bundle, per-scene ProRes HQ segments, content-keyed cache |
| Audio mix | `mix.py` (numpy) | ffmpeg `sidechaincompress` + `alimiter` + `loudnorm` |
| Voice | `narrate.py` (qwen-tts) | local IndexTTS-2.5 bridge over HTTP |
| Word timing | `asr.py` (mlx-whisper) | `openai-whisper` + forced alignment against the known script (`py/align.py`) |
| Chromium | system Chrome | the Edge that ships with Windows |
| ffmpeg/ffprobe | `brew install` | bundled static binaries from npm |

dsh-papercut README · Why this exists：No WSL. No Homebrew. No `ffmpeg` on `PATH`. Python is only needed for two leaf scripts
(forced alignment, CJK font subsetting), and the plugin calls the interpreter you point it at.

dsh-papercut README · The six tools：| Tool | Arguments | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `papercut_list` | — | Existing episodes, their duration, scene count and whether a render exists |
| `papercut_plan` | `idea`, `slug?`, `comp?`, `lines?` | Scaffolds the episode and returns the 7-line script brief |
| `papercut_storyboard` | `slug` | Camera / cut / SFX table derived from the real frame plan |
| `papercut_voice` | `slug`, `engine?`, `force?`, `model?`, `keepWarm?` | Local TTS per line, silence trim, forced word alignment, `voiceover.wav` + captions + plan |
| `papercut_render` | `slug`, `force?`, `workers?`, `conc?` | Segmented Remotion render, then one x264 pass with the audio bed |
| `papercut_qa` | `slug`, `every?`, `scale?` | Contact sheets every N frames, numbered, for visual review |

dsh-papercut README · The six tools：Everything else — composing scenes, writing the hook, choosing assets — is the agent's job,
guided by nine skills.

dsh-papercut README · The nine skills：Installed into `<DSH_HOME>/skills` by `npm run skills`, so DSH picks them up live:

`papercut-explainer` (router / end-to-end) · `papercut-strategy` · `papercut-hook` ·
`papercut-script` · `papercut-storyboard` · `papercut-build` · `papercut-voice` ·
`papercut-qa` · `papercut-setup` (toolchain doctor for this machine).

Say "make a papercut reel about X" and the router takes it from there.

dsh-papercut README · What the workspace must look like：`dsh-papercut` drives a *workspace* directory holding the upstream library and the render app.
The plugin finds it by walking up from its own package folder (and then from the current working
directory) looking for `app/node_modules` + `src/papercut-explainer-main/library`, so a linked
checkout and an npm-installed copy both work without configuration. Point it elsewhere with
`root` in `cordis.patch.yml`, or the `PAPERCUT_ROOT` env var.

dsh-papercut README · 为什么要有这个插件：上游 [papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) 的 Remotion 素材库
很好，但工具链是 27 个给 macOS 写的 bash / Python 脚本（`rsync`、`mlx-whisper`、
Homebrew 的 `ffmpeg`、`readlink -f`）。本插件把所有碰系统的部分都改写成了 Node，
所以在一台干净的 Windows 上就能跑通全链路：

dsh-papercut README · 为什么要有这个插件：| 环节 | 上游 | 这里 |
|---|---|---|
| 编排渲染 | `render.py` + `render.sh` | `src/node/render.js` —— 一次 bundle、逐场景 ProRes HQ 分段、内容键缓存 |
| 音频混音 | `mix.py`（numpy） | ffmpeg `sidechaincompress` + `alimiter` + `loudnorm` |
| 配音 | `narrate.py`（qwen-tts） | 本地 IndexTTS-2.5 的 HTTP 桥 |
| 逐词时间 | `asr.py`（mlx-whisper） | `openai-whisper` + 对着已知原稿做强制对齐（`py/align.py`） |
| 浏览器 | 系统 Chrome | Windows 自带的 Edge |
| ffmpeg/ffprobe | `brew install` | npm 里带的静态二进制 |

dsh-papercut README · 为什么要有这个插件：不需要 WSL。不需要 Homebrew。`PATH` 里不用有 `ffmpeg`。Python 只用于两个叶子脚本
（强制对齐、中文字体子集化），解释器路径由你在配置里指定。

dsh-papercut README · 六个工具：| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `papercut_list` | — | 列出已有集、时长、场景数、是否已渲染 |
| `papercut_plan` | `idea`, `slug?`, `comp?`, `lines?` | 生成骨架目录并返回 7 行脚本模板 |
| `papercut_storyboard` | `slug` | 从真实帧计划反推运镜 / 转场 / 音效表 |
| `papercut_voice` | `slug`, `engine?`, `force?`, `model?`, `keepWarm?` | 逐行本地合成、裁静音、强制对齐，产出 `voiceover.wav` + 字幕 + 帧计划 |
| `papercut_render` | `slug`, `force?`, `workers?`, `conc?` | 分段渲染后一次 x264 编码并混入音轨 |
| `papercut_qa` | `slug`, `every?`, `scale?` | 每 N 帧抽一张带帧号的 contact sheet，供人/模型看图验收 |
dsh-papercut README · 六个工具：其余的事 —— 写场景、写钩子、挑素材 —— 是 agent 的活，由九个技能引导。

`papercut-explainer`（总入口 / 路由）· `papercut-strategy` · `papercut-hook` ·
`papercut-script` · `papercut-storyboard` · `papercut-build` · `papercut-voice` ·
`papercut-qa` · `papercut-setup`（本机工具链体检）。

dsh-papercut README · 工作区长什么样：`dsh-papercut` 驱动的是一个**工作区**目录，里面放上游素材库和渲染工程。
插件会从自己的包目录（再退到当前工作目录）逐级向上找 `app/node_modules` +
`src/papercut-explainer-main/library`，所以 `link:` 装法和从 npm 装的副本都能零配置跑。
要指到别处就用 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `root`，或设 `PAPERCUT_ROOT` 环境变量。

```
<root>/
  app/                          Remotion 工程（node_modules 里有 remotion / ffmpeg-static / ...）
  src/papercut-explainer-main/  上游 MIT 素材库（kit、音频引擎、场景模板）
  episodes/<slug>/              一集一个目录

用 `papercut-setup`（或 `node tools/bin/papercut.mjs list`）查看缺什么。

dsh-papercut README · 环境要求：- **Windows 10/11**，装有 Edge（任何较新的 Edge 都带 Remotion 需要的 headless Chromium）
- **Node 22+**
- 一个 Python 3.11 venv，装有 `openai-whisper` + `fonttools` —— 只给对齐器和中文字体
  子集化用。在插件配置里用 `python:` 指过去。
- **可选**：`127.0.0.1:7865` 上的本地 TTS HTTP 桥（IndexTTS-2.5）。插件只探 `/health`
  并告诉你该怎么起服务；它**不会**自己去拉模型 —— 那会白占显存。
